paper.title: An Intuitive Synthesizer of Continuous-Interaction Sounds: Rubbing, Scratching, and Rolling
paper.authors: Simon Conan, Etienne Thoret, Mitsuko Aramaki, Olivier Derrien, Charles Gondre, Solvi Ystad, Richard Kronland-Martinet

author_video.license: Author companion media; no redistribution license advertised.
author_video.use: Independent isolated object hit, training/held-out continuous interaction excerpts, and visible action controls. Source input is unchanged.

implementation: Independent equation implementation; uses shared native Conan TASLP rolling calibration and core random/modal/GPU primitives. No author implementation was available.
unavailable: Gesture time series and velocity calibration
inferred: Modes from isolated hit plus first two seconds of rubbing
Gesture drive from visible action-panel indicator
Per-action cutoff and gain, scratching density from first two seconds only
heldout: Last four seconds of fixed-action excerpts; entire transition excerpt. See docs/Continuous.md and generated metrics.json.
